visualCharacteristics.purpose: Fixed row of equal bordered tiles, each with its own mixed content
visualCharacteristics.description:
Three equal bordered tiles in a fixed 3-column grid (stacks on mobile). Small uppercase blue eyebrow labels, uppercase "PER SAPERNE DI PIÙ >" links. Third tile is a dark photo slider (Lightbox blog) with white text and dot pagination.
Three bordered tiles. Tile 1: eyebrow + big blue uppercase title + link; Tile 2: document list with dates and download/slideshare/webcast icons + archive link; Tile 3: calendar icon, big "9M2026", event text, event date, link.
Same bordered 3-tile grid as section 6: promo tile, paginated News Operatori list (title link + date + share, dot pagination) + "Tutte le news operatori" link, promo tile.

contentPattern.summary:
Three equal bordered tiles in a fixed grid with eyebrow label, mixed content and bottom uppercase link.
Same 3-tile bordered grid as section 3 (reuse).
Same 3-tile bordered grid as section 3 (reuse).
contentPattern.structure: one row per tile row, one cell per tile. In a tile: optional short first paragraph = eyebrow; heading = title; a paragraph whose link text is its own URL becomes an embedded iframe; a list with more than 3 items is paginated with dots; two or more images turn the tile into an image slider (each image starts a slide); a trailing link-only paragraph is the tile CTA pinned to the bottom
contentPattern.sourceContent:
Tile 1: label "Fabbisogno energetico", embedded chart iframe, link "Per saperne di più"; Tile 2: label "Comunicati stampa", paginated list of press releases (title link + date + share), link "Tutti i comunicati"; Tile 3: Lightbox blog slider (3 articles: image, title, "Leggi l'articolo")

usage: Homepage rows of three tiles: chart embed, press-release list, blog slider, financial results, document list, calendar event, news list.
reuseGuidance: Use for a fixed set of different tiles side by side. For look-alike repeating items use a cards variant.
